rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The opening supplication omits the vocative particle and possessive suffix for brevity: it means O my Lord.
rows.anchor: هذا تفسير الدعاء وأصله يا ربي فحذف حرف النداء والمضاف اليه اختصار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Bone is singled out as the body's pillar and firmest part; if it weakens, the rest loses strength, and its singular can represent the body's weakness.
rows.anchor: ضعف وخص العظم لأنه عمود البدن وبه قوامه فاذا وهن تداعى وتساقطت قوته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The spreading white hair is likened to spreading flames; شيبا is a specification, and the image conveys the whiteness and spread of age.
rows.anchor: تمييز أي فشافى رأسي الشيب واشتعلت النار إذا تفرقت في التهابها وصارت شعلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nasafi ranks the wording above simpler statements of old age: saying the body weakened and hair grayed adds detail, while the bone phrase conveys it by metonymy.
rows.anchor: وأقوى منه ضعف بدني وشاب رأسي ففيه مزيد والتقرير للتفصيل وأقوى منه وهنت عظام بدني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sequence intensifies through أنا وهنت عظام بدني, إني وهنت بدني, and إني وهنت العظام من بدني, progressively sharpening the expression.
rows.anchor: وأقوى منه أنا وهنت عظام بدني وأقوى منه إني وهنت بدني وأقوى منه إني وهنت العظام من بدني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Omitting the intermediary body and using the singular bone makes the expression still stronger; weakness can affect the whole collectively without every bone failing individually.
rows.anchor: وأقوى منه إني وهنت العظام مني ففيه ترك توسيط البدن وأقوى منه إني وهن العظم مني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The metaphor replaces the literal statement that his head grayed; attributing the blaze to the head and omitting its owner make the image more comprehensive and forceful.
rows.anchor: ولهذا تركت الحقيقة في شاب رأسي إلى أبلغ وهي الاستعارة فحصل اشتعل شيب رأسي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nasafi calls اشتعل الرأس شيبا more eloquent because the head is the hair's source, the image covers the whole head, and the listener knows it is Zechariah's head from context.
rows.anchor: وأبلغ منه واشتعل الرأس شيبا ففيه اكتفاء بعلم المخاطب أنه رأس زكريا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: بدعائك is a verbal noun annexed to its object and means my calling upon You.
rows.anchor: مصدر ومضاف إلى المفعول أي بدعائي اياك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: شقيا means unsuccessful: Zechariah had previously been answered and made happy by his prayer rather than disappointed.
rows.anchor: أي كنت مستجاب الدعوة قبل اليوم سعيدا به غير شقي فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The expressions سعد بحاجته and مشقي distinguish someone who obtains a need from someone who fails to obtain it.
rows.anchor: يقال سعد فلان بحاجته إذا ظفر بها ومشقي إذا خاب ولم ينلها

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: An anecdote tells of a needy man reminding a benefactor of earlier kindness; the benefactor welcomed him for returning in need and granted his request.
rows.anchor: وعن بعضهم أن محتاجا سأله وقال أنا الذي احسنت إلى وقت كذا فقال مرحبا بمن توسل بنا إلينا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mawali are Zechariah's agnatic relatives, brothers and cousins; they were corrupt Israelites, so he feared they would change the religion and rule his community badly.
rows.anchor: هم عصبته اخوته وبنو عمه وكانوا شرار بني اسرائيل فخافهم أن يغيروا الدين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He therefore asks for a righteous descendant from his own loins who can succeed him in caring for the community and revive the religion.
rows.anchor: فطلب عقبا صالحا من صلبه يقتدى به في احياء الدين

rows.speaker: مكي
rows.claim: Makki reads the phrase with a shortened form and fathah on the yāʾ, as in هداي.
rows.anchor: وبالقصر وفتح الياء كهداي مكي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: من ورائي means after my death, but it cannot grammatically modify خفت because fear cannot occur after his death.
rows.anchor: وهذا الظرف لا يتعلق بخفت لأن وجود خوفه بعد موته لا يتصور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One parsing attaches من ورائي to an omitted phrase or to the sense of succession in الموالي: he fears their changing the religion and mismanaging succession after him.
rows.anchor: ولكن بمحذوف أو بمعنى الولاية في الموالي أي خفت فعل الموالي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another explanation takes the mawali as those who will assume authority after his death.
rows.anchor: أو خفت الذين يلون الأمر من ورائي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His wife was barren and unable to bear children.
rows.anchor: ﴿ وكانت امرأتي عاقرا ﴾ عقيما لا تلد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: From Your presence means a child created without ordinary means, since his wife was not fit for childbirth.
rows.anchor: اختراعا منك بلا سبب لأن امرأتي لا تصلح للولادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The requested ولي is a son who will take up God's affair after Zechariah.
rows.anchor: ﴿ وليا ﴾ ابنا يلي أمرك بعدي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: With both verbs in the indicative, يرثني and يرث are adjectives qualifying وليا: the son inherits Zechariah's knowledge and the prophethood of Jacob's family.
rows.anchor: برفعهما صفة لوليا أي هب لي ولدا وارثا مني العلم ومن آل يعقوب النبوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Inheritance of prophethood means the heir is fit to receive revelation, not that prophethood itself is inherited.
rows.anchor: ومعنى وراثة النبوة أنه يصلح لأن يوحى اليه ولم يرد أن نفس النبوة تورث

rows.speaker: أبو عمرو وعلي
rows.claim: Abu Amr and Ali read both verbs in the jussive as a response to the supplication; the verbs may be used with or without من.
rows.anchor: وبجزمهما أبو عمرو وعلى على أنه جواب للدعاء يقال ورثته وورثت منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Jacob meant is Jacob son of Isaac.
rows.anchor: ﴿ من آل يعقوب ﴾ يعقوب بن إسحاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: رضيا can mean one whom God approves or one content with God and His decree.
rows.anchor: مرضيا ترضاه أو راضيا عنك وبحكمك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God answered Zechariah's prayer and personally named Yahya, honoring him by doing so.
rows.anchor: تولى الله تسميته تشريفا له نبشرك بالتخفيف حمزة

rows.speaker: حمزة
rows.claim: Hamza recites يبشرك in the light form.
rows.anchor: نبشرك بالتخفيف حمزة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: سميا may mean that nobody before him bore the name Yahya; an unusual name merits distinction.
rows.anchor: لم يسم أحد بيحيى قبله وهذا دليل على أن الاسم الغريب جدير بالاثرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, سميا means peer or equal: Yahya had no equal in never sinning, being born to an elderly couple, and being ḥaṣūr.
rows.anchor: وقيل مثلا وشبيها ولم يكن له مثل في أنه لم يعص ولم يهم بمعصية قط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Anى means how; Zechariah is seeking to learn the manner, not expressing disbelief or deeming the promise impossible.
rows.anchor: ليس هذا باستبعاد بل هو استكشاف أنه بأي طريق يكون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He asks whether a child will be granted despite their condition or whether he and his wife will become young again.
rows.anchor: أنه بأي طريق يكون أيوهب له وهو وامرأته بتلك الحال أم يحولان شابين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: عتيّا means dryness and stiffness in the joints and bones from extreme age, like dry wood.
rows.anchor: وهو اليبس والجساوة في المفاصل والعظام

rows.speaker: حمزة وعلى وحفص
rows.claim: Hamza, Ali, and Hafs pronounce the initial letters of عتيا, صليا, جثيا, and بكيا with kasrah, except that بكيا is excluded.
rows.anchor: عتيا وصليا وجثيا وبكيا بكسر الاوائل حمزة وعلى وحفص الا في بكيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On one parsing, the kāf is nominative: the matter is so, confirming Zechariah, followed by the words قال ربك.
rows.anchor: الكاف رفع أي الأمر كذلك تصديق له ثم ابتدأ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the kāf is accusative under قال and points to an unspecified matter explained by قال ربك.
rows.anchor: أو نصب بقال وذلك إشارة إلى مبهم يفسره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creating Yahya from two elderly parents is easy for God.
rows.anchor: أي خلق يحيى من كبيرين سهل

rows.speaker: حمزة وعلي
rows.claim: Hamza and Ali read خَلَقْتُكَ as خلقناك, We created you.
rows.anchor: أوجدتك من قبل يحيى خلقناك حمزة وعلى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Before God created him, Zechariah was nothing, since what does not exist is not a thing.
rows.anchor: ﴿ ولم تك شيئا ﴾ لأن المعدوم ليس بشيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The requested sign is a way for Zechariah to recognize that his wife has conceived.
rows.anchor: علامة أعرف بها حبل امرأتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sويّا describes Zechariah's intact limbs and tongue: he is prevented from speaking although he is not mute or physically defective.
rows.anchor: حال من ضمير تكلم أي حال كونك سوى الاعضاء واللسان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prohibition lasts three days and their nights: mentioning days in Aal Imran and nights here conventionally includes each period's counterpart.
rows.anchor: ودل ذكر الليالي هنا والايام في آل عمران على أن المنع من الكلام استمر به ثلاثة أيام ولياليهن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mihrab is Zechariah's place of prayer, where his people were waiting; he could not speak.
rows.anchor: من موضع صلاته وكانوا ينتظرونه ولم يقدر أن يتكلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He communicated by pointing with his finger, and ان introduces the explanation of what he conveyed.
rows.anchor: ﴿ فأوحى إليهم ﴾ أشار باصبعه ﴿ أن سبحوا ﴾

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: سبحوا here means pray, specifically the dawn and afternoon prayers.
rows.anchor: ﴿ أن سبحوا ﴾ صلوا وان هي المفسرة ﴿ بكرة وعشيا ﴾ صلاة الفجر والعصر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The address يا يحيى means God gave him Yahya and spoke to him after his birth, when he could understand address.
rows.anchor: أي وهبنا له يحيى وقلنا له بعد ولادته وأوان الخطاب يا يحيى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Book is the Torah, and taking it with قوة means seriousness, supported by divine enabling and aid.
rows.anchor: التوراة ﴿ بقوة ﴾ حال أي بجد واستظهار بالتوفيق والتأييد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The الحكم given in childhood is wisdom: understanding the Torah and religious jurisprudence.
rows.anchor: الحكمة وهو فهم التوراة والفقه في الدين

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: A report says children invited Yahya to play while he was still a child, and he replied that they were not created for play.
rows.anchor: قيل دعاه الصبيان إلى اللعب وهو صبي فقال ما للعب خلقنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ḥanān means compassion and mercy toward his parents and others, and is coordinated with الحكم.
rows.anchor: شفقة ورحمة لابويه وغيرهما عطفا عى الحكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: From Our presence means from God; zakāh means purity and righteousness, and Yahya did not deliberately commit sin.
rows.anchor: ﴿ من لدنا ﴾ من عندنا ﴿ وزكاة ﴾ طهارة وصلاحا فلم يعمد بذنب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He was devout, Muslim, and obedient.
rows.anchor: ﴿ وزكاة ﴾ طهارة وصلاحا فلم يعمد بذنب ﴿ وكان تقيا ﴾ مسلما مطيعا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Yahya was dutiful and did not disobey his parents.
rows.anchor: ﴿ وبرا بوالديه ﴾ وبارا بهما لا يعصيهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He was neither arrogant nor disobedient to God.
rows.anchor: ﴿ ولم يكن جبارا ﴾ متكبرا ﴿ عصيا ﴾ عاصيا لربه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's peace is safety for Yahya: from Satan at birth, the grave's trials at death, and the greatest terror at resurrection.
rows.anchor: ﴿ وسلام عليه ﴾ آمان من الله له ﴿ يوم ولد ﴾ من أن يناله الشيطان ﴿ ويوم يموت ﴾ من فتاني القبر

rows.speaker: ابن عيينة
rows.claim: Ibn Uyayna says the resurrection is the most desolate of the three stations.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عيينة إنها أوحش المواطن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad is told to recite Mary's story from the Quran so listeners can learn what happened to her.
rows.anchor: ﴿ واذكر ﴾ يا محمد ﴿ في الكتاب ﴾ القرآن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The time clause is a genitive apposition to Mary by inclusion; the story's purpose is to highlight the extraordinary event that occurred then.
rows.anchor: بدل من مريم بدل اشتمال إذ الأحيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: انتبذت means she withdrew from her family.
rows.anchor: ﴿ انتبذت من أهلها ﴾ أي اعتزلت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The eastern place may have been a secluded worship place east of the Temple or her home, away from people.
rows.anchor: ﴿ مكانا ﴾ ظرف ﴿ شرقيا ﴾ أي تخلت للعبادة في مكان مما يلي شرقي بيت المقدس

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another view says she sat on the eastern side of the Temple to wash after menstruation.
rows.anchor: وقيل قعدت في مشرقه للاغتسال من الحيض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mary made a screen between herself and her family to conceal herself while washing.
rows.anchor: جعلت بينها وبين أهلها حجابا يسترها لتغتسل وراءه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Spirit is Gabriel; the possessive addition honors him, and he is called Spirit because religion lives through him and revelation.
rows.anchor: جبريل عليه السلام والإضافة للتشريف وإنما سمي روحا لأن الدين يحيا به وبوحيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gabriel appeared as a well-proportioned human, a handsome, beardless young man with curly hair.
rows.anchor: أي فتمثل لها جبريل في صورة آدمي شاب أمرد وضئ الوجه جعد الشعر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He took human form so Mary would feel at ease and hear him; an angelic appearance would have frightened her and prevented her from listening.
rows.anchor: وإنما مثل لها في صورة الإنسان لتستأنس بكلامه ولا تنفر عنه ولو بدالها في صورة الملائكة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mary seeks refuge in the Merciful; her conditional wording means she appeals to God if the man is someone from whom piety can be expected.
rows.anchor: أي إن كان يرجى منك أن تتقي الله فإني عائذة به منك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gabriel reassures Mary that he is not a human intruder but the messenger of the Lord from whom she sought refuge.
rows.anchor: ﴿ قال ﴾ جبريل عليه السلام ﴿ إنما أنا رسول ربك ﴾ أمنها مما خافت وأخبر أنه ليس بآدمي

rows.speaker: أبو عمرو ونافع
rows.claim: Abu Amr and Nafi read ليهب لك, attributing the giving of the boy to God.
rows.anchor: أو لأكون سببا في هبة الغلام بالنفخ في الدرع ليهب لك أي الله أبو عمرو ونافع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Under the wording لأهب, Gabriel would be a means by blowing into her garment for God to grant the child.
rows.anchor: بإذن الله تعالى أو لأكون سببا في هبة الغلام بالنفخ في الدرع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zakiyyan means pure of sins, or growing in goodness and blessing.
rows.anchor: طاهرا من الذنوب أو ناميا على الخير والبركة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mary asks how she could have a son when no husband has touched her in marriage and she has not been sexually immoral; ordinarily conception comes through one of those two routes.
rows.anchor: زوج بالنكاح ﴿ ولم أك بغيا ﴾ فاجرة تبغي الرجال أي تطلب الشهوة من أي رجل كان

rows.speaker: المبرد
rows.claim: Al-Mubarrad analyzes baghiyy as a feminine faʿūl form derived from baghawiyy, with the wāw changed and assimilated and the ghayn kasra assimilated; this explains the missing feminine tāʾ.
rows.anchor: والبغي فعول عند المبرد بغوي فقلبت الواو ياء وأدغمت وكسرت الغين اتباعا

rows.speaker: غيره
rows.claim: Other grammarians derive baghiyy from faʿīl; it lacks feminine tāʾ because it has a passive sense, though an active form can likewise lack tāʾ, as in raḥmat Allāh qarīb.
rows.anchor: وعند غيره هي فعيل ولم تلحقها الهاء لأنها بمعنى مفعولة وإن كانت بمعنى فاعلة فهو قد يشبه به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gabriel confirms Mary's account: no man touched her through marriage or illicit sex.
rows.anchor: ﴿ قال ﴾ جبريل ﴿ كذلك ﴾ أي الأمر كما قلت لم يمسك رجل نكاحا أو سفاحا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God says that granting a child without a father is easy for Him.
rows.anchor: أي اعطاء الولد بلا أب علي سهل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The purpose clause may depend on an omitted explanation: God did this to make Jesus a sign to people.
rows.anchor: تعليل معللة محذوف أي ولنجعله آية للناس فعلنا ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the clause coordinates with an implicit purpose: to demonstrate God's power and make Jesus a sign and proof of it.
rows.anchor: أو هو معطوف على تعليل مضمر اي لنبين به قدرتنا ولنجعله آية للناس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus is a mercy from God for those who believe in him.
rows.anchor: ﴿ ورحمة منا ﴾ لمن آمن به ﴿ وكان ﴾ خلق عيسى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His creation was decreed and written on the Preserved Tablet; once Mary was reassured, Gabriel blew into her garment and the breath reached her womb.
rows.anchor: مقدرا مسطورا في اللوح فلما اطمأنت إلى قوله منها فنفخ في جيب درعها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mary was thirteen, ten, or twenty years old when she conceived.
rows.anchor: وكان سنها ثلاث عشرة سنه أو عشر أو عشرين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: She withdrew while carrying Jesus in her womb, far from her family beyond a mountain, fearing blame when she realized she was pregnant.
rows.anchor: ﴿ فانتبذت به ﴾ اعتزلت وهو فى بطنها والجار والمجرور فى موضع الحال

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas says the gestation lasted one hour, and she delivered as soon as she conceived.
rows.anchor: عن ابن عباس رضى الله عنهما كانت مدة الحمل ساعه واحده كما حملته نبذته

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Other reports give the pregnancy as six, seven, or eight months; one says no child born at eight months survived except Jesus.
rows.anchor: وقيل ستة أشهر وقيل سبعه وقيل ثمانيه ولم يعش مولود وضع لثمانيه إلا عيسى

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another report says she conceived and gave birth within an hour.
rows.anchor: وقيل حملته فى ساعة ووضعته في ساعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أجاءها is explained as brought her to the place or compelled her there; after transfer from جاء its usage shifted to compulsion.
rows.anchor: جاء بها وقيل الجأها وهو منقول من جاء إلا أن استعماله قد تغير بعد النقل إلى معنى الالجاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Makhāḍ means labor pains; the palm's trunk was dry and the season winter.
rows.anchor: ﴿ المخاض ﴾ وجع الولادة ﴿ إلى جذع النخلة ﴾ اصلها وكانت يابسة وكان الوقت شتاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The definite palm may be a known tree, or a generic definite meaning this tree; God directed Mary to it for dates, customary food for a woman after childbirth.
rows.anchor: وتعريفها مشعر بأنها كانت نخله معروفه وجاز أن يكون التعريف للجنس أي جذع هذه الشجرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mary's wish to have died is an expression of distress at what befell her; this means before that day.
rows.anchor: ﴿ قالت ﴾ جزعا مما أصابها ﴿ يا ليتني مت قبل هذا ﴾ اليوم

rows.speaker: حمزة وحفص
rows.claim: Hamza and Hafs read the nūn of نسيا with fatḥah; the other readers use kasrah, with the same meaning.
rows.anchor: ﴿ وكنت نسيا منسيا ﴾ شيئا متروكا لا يعرف ولا يذكر بفتح النون حمزة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A forgotten thing is something abandoned and no longer remembered, fit to be discarded because of its insignificance.
rows.anchor: شيئا متروكا لا يعرف ولا يذكر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The caller beneath Mary may be Gabriel, positioned lower than her, or Jesus speaking from beneath her skirt; in a reading reported for Medinan and most Kufic readers, the pronoun refers to the palm and the subject is implicit, either Jesus or Gabriel.
rows.anchor: أي الذي تحتها فمن فاعل وهو جبريل عليه السلام لأنه كان بمكان منخفض عنها أو عيسى عليه السلام لأنه خاطبها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The call comforts her about loneliness, food, drink, and what people will say; an here explains the words that follow.
rows.anchor: لا تهتمي بالوحدة وعدم الطعام والشراب ومقالة الناس وان بمعنى أي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Under you can mean nearby, or under your command, such that the stream obeys if ordered to flow or stop.
rows.anchor: قربك أو تحت أمرك إن أمرته أن يجري جرى وأن أمرته أن يقف وقف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Most commentators take sariyyan as a small stream; the Prophet explained it as a brook.
rows.anchor: نهرا صغيرا عند الجمهور وسئل النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عن السرى فقال هو الجدول

rows.speaker: الحسن
rows.claim: Al-Hasan takes sariyyan to mean a noble master, namely Jesus.
rows.anchor: وعن الحسن سيدا كريما يعني عيسى عليه السلام

rows.speaker: خالد بن صفوان
rows.claim: Khalid ibn Safwan told al-Hasan that Arabs call a brook sariyyan; al-Hasan agreed and returned to the stream interpretation.
rows.anchor: وروى أن خالد بن صفوان قال له ان العرب تسمى الجدول سريا فقال الحسن صدقت ورجع إلى قوله

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas says Jesus or Gabriel struck the ground with his heel, bringing forth fresh water; the dry stream flowed, and the palm turned green, bore fruit, and ripened.
rows.anchor: وقال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما ضرب عيسى أو جبريل عليهما السلام بعقبه الأرض فظهرت عين ماء عذب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: هزي means shake, and إليك directs the movement toward yourself.
rows.anchor: ﴿ وهزي ﴾ حركي ﴿ إليك ﴾ إلى نفسك

rows.speaker: أبو علي
rows.claim: Abu Ali considers the bāʾ in بجذع extra, so the construction means shake the palm trunk.
rows.anchor: قال أبو علي الباء زائدة أي هزي جذع النخلة

rows.speaker: مكي ومدني وشامي وأبو عمرو وعلي وأبو بكر
rows.claim: These readers assimilate the first tāʾ in تساقط into the second; its underlying form has two tāʾs.
rows.anchor: بادغام التاء الأولى في الثانية مكي ومدني وشامي وأبو عمرو وعلي وأبو بكر والأصل تتساقط

rows.speaker: حمزة
rows.claim: Hamza reads تساقط with fatḥah on tāʾ and qāf, dropping the second tāʾ and lightening the sīn.
rows.anchor: وتساقط بفتح التاء والقاف وطرح التاء الثانية وتخفيف السين حمزة

rows.speaker: يعقوب وسهل وحماد ونصير
rows.claim: Yaqub, Sahl, Hammad, and Nasir read يساقط with yāʾ and qāf in fatḥah and a doubled sīn.
rows.anchor: ويساقط بفتح الياء والقاف وتشديد السين يعقوب وسهل وحماد ونصير

rows.speaker: حفص
rows.claim: Hafs reads تساقط as a form of mutual action; the feminine and masculine forms make the palm or trunk respectively the subject, completing nine readings.
rows.anchor: وتساقط حفص من المفاعلة وتسقط ويسقط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: رطبا is either a specification or a direct object depending on the reading, and جنيا means freshly picked.
rows.anchor: ﴿ رطبا ﴾ تمييز أو مفعول به على حسب القراءة ﴿ جنيا ﴾ طريا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Dates are customary food for postpartum women; some say nothing is better for them than dates or for the sick than honey.
rows.anchor: وقالوا التمر للنفساء عادة من ذلك الوقت وقيل ما للنفساء خير من الرطب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: She is told to eat the dates, drink from the stream, and find comfort in Jesus; عينًا is a specification meaning that she should be pleased.
rows.anchor: ﴿ فكلي ﴾ من الجني ﴿ واشربي ﴾ من السري ﴿ وقري عينا ﴾ بالولد الرضي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أما is formed from conditional إن combined with ما and assimilated.
rows.anchor: ﴿ فأما ﴾ أصله إن ما فضمت ان الشرطية إلى ما وأدغمت فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fast is abstention from speech: people fasted from talking as they did from food and drink.
rows.anchor: أي فإن رأيت آدميا يسألك عن حالك فقولي إني نذرت للرحمن صمتا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, it was a literal fast whose practice included silence; the Prophet forbade silence-fasting, so that practice was abrogated for Muslims.
rows.anchor: وقيل صياما حقيقة وكان صيامهم فيه الصمت فكان الزامه الزامه وقد نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن صوم الصمت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mary was ordered to stay silent because Jesus would vindicate her and because this would keep her from arguing with fools.
rows.anchor: وإنما أمرت أن تنذر السكوت لأن عيسى عليه السلام يكفيها الكلام بما يبرئ به ساحتها ولئلا تجادل السفهاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse supports the duty to ignore a fool: nothing checks one like turning away, while attention lets him run free.
rows.anchor: وفيه دليل على أن السكوت عن السفيه واجب وما قدع سفيه بمثل الاعراض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Her gesture conveyed that she had vowed the fast; gesture can be called speech or a statement.
rows.anchor: وإنما أخبرتهم بأنها نذرت الصوم بالإشارة وقد تسمى الإشارة كلاما وقولا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A poet describes graves as speaking through faces that decay, using speech metaphorically.
rows.anchor: ألا ترى إلى قول الشاعر في وصف القبور وتكلمت عن أوجه تبلى

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another view says silence became obligatory after her statement, or that she was permitted to utter that much.
rows.anchor: وقيل كان وجوب الصمت بعد هذا الكلام أو سوغ لها هذا القدر بالنطق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Insيا here means a human being.
rows.anchor: ﴿ فلن أكلم اليوم إنسيا ﴾ آدميا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mary came to her people after recovering from postpartum bleeding, carrying Jesus as she approached them.
rows.anchor: ﴿ قومها ﴾ بعد ما طهرت من نفاسها ﴿ تحمله ﴾ حال منها أي أقبلت نحوهم حاملة إياه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They call the event extraordinary and strange; فريّ is related to cutting, as though it cuts across ordinary custom.
rows.anchor: بديعا عجيبا والفرى القطع كأنه يقطع العادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أخت هارون may refer to her brother Harun, who shared her father and was among Israel's best; alternatively she descended from Moses's brother Harun, a thousand years earlier.
rows.anchor: وكان أخاها من أبيها ومن أفضل بني اسرائيل أو هو أخو موسى عليه السلام وكانت من أعقابه وبينهما ألف سنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling her sister of Harun may mean a member of his people or a righteous person of her time; the speaker may be praising her by comparison or insulting her.
rows.anchor: وهذا كما يقال يا أخا همدان أي يا واحدا منهم أو رجل صال أو صالح في زمانها شبهوها به في الصلاح أو شتموها به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Her father Imran was not an adulterer and her mother Hannah was not a prostitute.
rows.anchor: ﴿ ما كان أبوك ﴾ عمران ﴿ امرأ سوء ﴾ زانيا ﴿ وما كانت أمك ﴾ حنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mary pointed to Jesus so he would answer; Jesus had told her not to grieve and to leave the response to him.
rows.anchor: إلى عيسى أن يجيبهم وذلك أن عيسى عليه السلام قال لها لا تحزني واحيلي بالجواب علي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another account says Gabriel instructed her to point to Jesus.
rows.anchor: وقيل امرها جبريل بذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Her people were angry and astonished; كان means that Jesus had come into existence as a child in the familiar cradle.
rows.anchor: ﴿ قالوا كيف نكلم من كان ﴾ حدث ووجد ﴿ في المهد ﴾ المعهود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God silenced Mary's speaking tongue and made the silent tongue speak, confessing servitude to God.
rows.anchor: ولما أسكتت بأمر الله لسانها الناطق أنطق الله اللسان الساكت حتى اعترف

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One view says Jesus was forty nights old; another says he was one day old.
rows.anchor: وهو ابن اربعين ليلة أو ابن يوم

rows.speaker: روي
rows.claim: A report says Jesus pointed with his index finger and spoke in a raised voice.
rows.anchor: روي انه أشار بسبابته وقال بصوت رفيع إني عبد الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His first words refute the Christians' claim about him.
rows.anchor: وفيه رد لقول النصارى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Book given to Jesus is the Gospel.
rows.anchor: ﴿ آتاني الكتاب ﴾ الانجيل ﴿ وجعلني نبيا ﴾ روى عن الحسن أنه كان في المهد نبيا

rows.speaker: الحسن
rows.claim: Al-Hasan says Jesus was already a prophet in the cradle and that his speech was his miracle.
rows.anchor: روى عن الحسن أنه كان في المهد نبيا وكلامه معجزته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, being given the Book and made a prophet was already fixed in God's decree, or a future certainty is phrased as already realized.
rows.anchor: وقيل معناه أن ذلك سبق في قضائه أو جعل الآتي لا محالة كأنه وجد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Blessed means beneficial wherever he is, or one who teaches goodness.
rows.anchor: ﴿ وجعلني مباركا أين ما كنت ﴾ نفاعا حيث كنت أو معلما للخير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God commanded him to pray and give zakat if he possessed wealth.
rows.anchor: ﴿ وأوصاني ﴾ وأمرني ﴿ بالصلاة والزكاة ﴾ إن ملكت مالا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zakat may mean the alms at the end of Ramadan or bodily purification; it may also mean that Jesus was commanded to tell others to pray and give zakat.
rows.anchor: وقيل صدقة الفطر أو تطهير البدن ويحتمل وأوصاني بأن آمركم بالصلاة والزكاة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ما دمت حيا is an accusative adverbial specifying the duration of his life.
rows.anchor: نصب على الظرف أي مدة حياتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus was dutiful to his mother, honoring and revering her.
rows.anchor: عطفا على مباركا أي بارا بها أكرمها وأعظمها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He was not arrogant or wretched through disobedience to his mother.
rows.anchor: ﴿ ولم يجعلني جبارا ﴾ متكبرا ﴿ شقيا ﴾ عاقا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The three days are temporal adverbials governed by the predicate.
rows.anchor: يوم ظرف والعامل فيه الخبر وهو على

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If the definite article refers back to Yahya's peace, the same peace at birth, death, and resurrection is directed to Jesus.
rows.anchor: أي ذلك السلام الموجه إلى يحيى في المواطن الثلاثة موجه إلى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If the article is generic, the verse means that peace as a kind rests upon Jesus and indirectly implies a curse on Mary's opponents in this dispute.
rows.anchor: وان كان للجنس فالمعنى وجنس السلام على وفيه تعريض باللعنه على أعداء مريم وابنها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In ذلك عيسى ابن مريم, the demonstrative is subject and Jesus its predicate; son of Mary is an apposition or second predicate, rejecting the Christian claim that he is God or God's son.
rows.anchor: نعته أو خبر ثان أي ذلك الذي قال أني كذا وكذا عيسى بن مريم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: قول الحق can mean God's word: القول means word and الحق means God; Jesus is called God's word because he was born by God's command Be, without a father.
rows.anchor: كلمة الله فالقول الكلمة والحق الله وقيل له كلمة الله لأنه ولد بقوله كن بلا واسطة أب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase قول الحق may be a predicate after another predicate, predicate of an omitted subject, or apposition to Jesus.
rows.anchor: وارتفاعه على أنه خبر بعد خبر أو خبر مبتدأ محذوف أو بدل من عيسى

rows.speaker: الشامي وعاصم
rows.claim: Al-Shami and Asim read قول الحق in the accusative as praise or as a verbal noun meaning I speak the truth: he is Mary's son, not a deity.
rows.anchor: ونصبه شامي وعاصم على المدح أو على المصدر أي أقول قول الحق هو ابن مريم وليس باله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disputants either doubt Jesus or argue about him: Jews call him a lying magician, while Christians call him God's son and one of three.
rows.anchor: يشكون من المرية الشك أو يختلفون من المراء فقالت اليهود ساحر كذاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is unfitting for God to take a child; the preposition من reinforces the negation, and Glory be to Him declares His transcendence.
rows.anchor: جيء بمن لتأكيد النفي ﴿ سبحانه ﴾ نزه ذاته عن اتخاذ الولد

rows.speaker: الشامي
rows.claim: Al-Shami reads فيكون in the subjunctive.
rows.anchor: ﴿ إذا قضى أمرا فإنما يقول له كن فيكون ﴾ بالنصب شامي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus was brought into being when God said Be, without a father; a being with this power is unlike an animal that begets offspring.
rows.anchor: كما قال لعيسى كن فكان من غير أب ومن كان متصفا بهذا كان منزها ان يشبه الحيوان الوالد

rows.speaker: الشامي والكوفي
rows.claim: Al-Shami and the Kufans read إِنَّ اللهَ with kasrah as a new sentence in Jesus's speech: since he is God's servant, all people are God's servants and must worship Him.
rows.anchor: بالكسر شامي وكوفي على الابتداء وهو من كلام عيسى يعني كما أنا عبده فأنتم عبيده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: With fatḥah, the clause can coordinate with الصلاة والزكاة as another command to Jesus, or attach to the following command as its reason.
rows.anchor: ومن فتح عطف على بالصلاة أي وأوصاني بالصلاة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The straight path is worshipping God and associating nothing with Him.
rows.anchor: الذي ذكرت ﴿ صراط مستقيم ﴾ فاعبدوه ولا تشركوا به شيئا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The parties are factions that separated around their own views: Nestorians, Jacobites, and Melkites.
rows.anchor: الحزب الفرقة المنفردة برأيها عن غيرها وهم ثلاث فرق نسطورية ويعقوبية وملكانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: من بينهم may mean among Jesus's companions, among his people, or among all people; Christians differed about Jesus after he was raised.
rows.anchor: من بين أصحابه أو من بين قومه أو من بين الناس وذلك أن النصارى اختلفوا في عيسى حين رفع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The factions agreed to consult three scholars: Jacob said God descended to earth then ascended; Nestorius said God's son appeared as he wished then was raised; Melkon said Jesus was a created servant and prophet. Each group followed one.
rows.anchor: اتفقوا على ان يرجعوا إلى قول ثلاثة كانوا عندهم أعلم أهل زمانهم وهو يعقوب ونسطور وملكان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The unbelieving factions face woe; their dispute makes the claim about Jesus horrifying.
rows.anchor: من الاحزاب إذ الواحد منهم على الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The great day may be Judgment Day itself, attendance at its terror and reckoning, or the day as witness against them through angels, prophets, and limbs.
rows.anchor: هو يوم القيامة أو من شهودهم هول الحساب والجزاء في يوم القيامة أو من شهادة ذلك اليوم عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the phrase can mean the place or time of testimony, or their gathering to confer; the day is called great because of their outrageous claims about Jesus.
rows.anchor: أو من مكان الشهادة أو وقتها أو المراد يوم اجتماعهم للتشاور فيه وجعله عظيما لفظاعة ما شهدوا به في عيسى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The imperative wording expresses amazement; since God is not described as amazed, it means their hearing and sight will be astonishing after their worldly deafness and blindness.
rows.anchor: الجمهور على أن لفظه أمر ومعناه التعجب والله تعالى لا يوصف بالتعجب ولكن المراد أن إسماعهم وإبصارهم جدير بأن يتعجب منهما

rows.speaker: قتادة
rows.claim: Qatada says that if they were blind and deaf to truth in this world, they will be intensely hearing and seeing guidance on the day it cannot benefit them.
rows.anchor: قال قتادة إن عموا وصموا عن الحق في الدنيا فما أسمعهم وما أبصرهم بالهدى يوم لا ينفعهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pronoun in بهم is raised as an agent, as in أكرم بزيد; the sense is that Zayd is exceptionally noble.
rows.anchor: وبهم مرفوع المحل على الفاعلية كاكرم بزيد فمعناه كرم زيد جدا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: الظالمون replaces an expected pronoun; their wrongdoing was failing to listen and look when that could help, and worshipping what is unworthy of worship.
rows.anchor: أقيم الظاهر مقام المضمر أي لكنهم اليوم في الدنيا بظلمهم أنفسهم حيث تركوا الاستماع والنظر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their clear error is treating Jesus as a god despite the evident signs that he is created; this displays the extremity of their injustice.
rows.anchor: ظاهر وهو اعتقادهم عيسى إلها معبودا مع ظهور آثار الحدث فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Day of Regret is Judgment Day, when people regret what they missed.
rows.anchor: يوم القيامة لأنه يقع فيه الندم على ما فات

rows.speaker: حديث
rows.claim: A report says people will see the places in Paradise they could have had if they had believed.
rows.anchor: وفي الحديث إذا رأوا منازلهم في الجنة أن لو آمنوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: إذ may be an apposition to يوم الحسرة or a time expression governed by the verbal noun الحسرة.
rows.anchor: بدل من يوم الحسرة أو ظرف للحسرة وهو مصدر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the matter is concluded, the accounting is finished and the two groups depart to Paradise and Hell.
rows.anchor: فرغ من الحساب وتصادر الفريقان إلى الجنة والنار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People are warned while heedless of that moment and unbelieving in it; both descriptions are circumstantial clauses.
rows.anchor: هنا عن الإهتمام لذلك المقام ﴿ وهم لا يؤمنون ﴾ لا يصدقون به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God alone retains sovereignty and life when all creatures perish; من generalizes the statement over rational beings.
rows.anchor: أي نتفرد بالملك والبقاء عند تعميم الهلك والفناء وذكر من لتغليب العقلاء

rows.speaker: يعقوب
rows.claim: Yaqub reads the verb with yāʾ and jīm fatḥah, meaning they are returned to God and recompensed in full.
rows.anchor: بضم الياء وفتح الجيم وفتح الياء يعقوب أي يردون فيجازون جزاء وفاقا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad is to recount Abraham's story from the Quran to his people; the passage concerns Abraham and his father.
rows.anchor: لقومك ﴿ في الكتاب ﴾ القرآن ﴿ إبراهيم ﴾ قصته مع أبيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nafiʿ reads the word for prophet with a hamzah; the other reading has no hamzah.
rows.anchor: ﴿ إنه كان صديقا نبيا ﴾ بغير همزه وهمزه نافع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One explanation distinguishes the ṣiddīq, upright in deeds, from the truthful, upright in inward states; ṣiddīq is an intensive form like ḍaḥīk.
rows.anchor: قيل الصادق المستقيم فى الأفعال والصديق المستقيم فى الآحوال فالصديق من ابنية المبالغة ونظيره الضحيك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham's truthfulness was exceptional: he affirmed God's unseen matters, signs, books, and messengers, and was himself a prophet.
rows.anchor: والمراد فرط صدقه وكثرة ما صدق به من غيوب الله وآياته وكتبه ورسله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sentence praising Abraham is parenthetical between his name and the following appositional clause beginning with when he spoke to his father.
rows.anchor: وهذه الجملة وقعت اعتراضا بين إبراهيم وبين ما هو بدل منه وهو

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to remember Abraham means to recite and convey his story to people, as in the cited instruction to recite Abraham's account.
rows.anchor: لقومك ﴿ في الكتاب ﴾ القرآن ﴿ إبراهيم ﴾ قصته مع أبيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The time clause may attach to كان or to صديقا نبيا, describing Abraham as gathering the traits of the truthful and prophets when he addressed his father.
rows.anchor: وجاز ان يتعلق إذ بكان أو بصديقا نبيا اى كان جامعا لخصائص الصديقين والانبياء حين خاطب أباه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is the one who records the story in revelation; the command to remember it means the Messenger should recite and convey it to people.
rows.anchor: ان يتلو ذلك على الناس ويبلغه اياهم كقوله واتل عليهم نبأ إبراهيم وإلا فالله عزوعلا هو ذاكره

rows.speaker: ابن عامر
rows.claim: Ibn Amir reads the tāʾ in يا أبت with either kasrah or fatḥah; it substitutes for the possessive yāʾ, so one does not combine both.
rows.anchor: بكسر التاء وفتحها ابن عامر والتاء عوض من ياء الإضافه ولا يقال يا ابتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The idols neither hear nor see anything; the object is omitted but can be supplied as شيء.
rows.anchor: المفعول فيهما منسي غير منوى ويجوز أن يقدر اى لا يسمع شيئا ولا يبصر شيئا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In لا يغني عنك شيئا, شيئا may be a cognate accusative meaning no benefit at all, or a direct object in an idiom meaning it cannot help you.
rows.anchor: يحتمل ان يكون شيئا فى موضع المصدر اى شيئا من الاعناء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The knowledge that came to Abraham may be revelation or knowledge of God; ما may be a relative or descriptive pronoun.
rows.anchor: الوحى أو معرفة الرب ﴿ ما لم يأتك ﴾ ما في ما لا يسمع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham asks his father to follow him, promising to guide him to a straight path.
rows.anchor: ﴿ فاتبعني أهدك ﴾ ارشدك ﴿ صراطا سويا ﴾ مستقيما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worshipping Satan means obeying his prompting to worship idols; Satan disobeys the Merciful.
rows.anchor: لاتطعه فيما سول من عبادة الصنم ﴿ إن الشيطان كان للرحمن عصيا ﴾ عاصيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: خاف can mean I know; becoming Satan's ally means accompanying him in the Fire, with each following the other.
rows.anchor: قيل أعلم ﴿ أن يمسك عذاب من الرحمن فتكون للشيطان وليا ﴾ قرينا فى النار تليه ويليك

rows.speaker: حديث
rows.claim: A report says God told Abraham, His intimate friend, to improve his manners even with unbelievers and thereby enter the ranks of the righteous.
rows.anchor: أوحى إلى إبراهيم انك خليلى حسن خلقك ولو مع الكفار تدخل مداخل الابرار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham's repeated address يا أبت seeks his father's respect and affection despite his disbelief.
rows.anchor: وصدر كل نصيحة بقوله ياأبت توسلا إليه واستعطافا واشعارا بوجوب احترام الآب وان كان كافرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: First he asks about the cause of his father's error to awaken him: worshipping even a prophet would be manifest blindness, much less a stone or tree that cannot hear, see, avert harm, or grant needs.
rows.anchor: فطلب منه أولا العله فى خطئه طلب منبه على تماديه موقظ لافراطه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Then he gently invites him to truth, neither branding his father ignorant nor boasting of superior knowledge; he claims only some guidance his father lacks.
rows.anchor: ثم ثنى بدعوته إلى الحق مترفقا به متلطفا فلم يسم أباه بالجهل المفرط ولا نفسه بالعلم الفائق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The path analogy says that if two travel together and Abraham knows the way, his father should follow to avoid getting lost.
rows.anchor: وذلك علم الدلاله على الطريق السوى فهب أنى وإياك فى مسير وعندى معرفة بالهداية دونك فاتبعنى انجك من ان تضل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Next he forbids worship of Satan, who disobeys the source of all blessings, enticed the father into idolatry, and is the one truly being worshipped.
rows.anchor: الذي عصى الرحمن الذي جميع النعم منه أوقعك فى عبادة الصنم وزينها لك فأنت عابده فى الحقيقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Finally, Abraham warns of the bad outcome and its burden while speaking gently: he does not state punishment will certainly strike, but says he fears that some punishment may touch him.
rows.anchor: ثم ربع بتخويفه سوء العاقبة وما يجره ما هو فيه من التبعه والوبال مع مراعاة الآدب حيث لم يصرح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The indefinite عذاب minimizes the prospect of punishment, while Satan's alliance and inclusion among his followers is worse than punishment, just as God's approval exceeds reward.
rows.anchor: بل قال أخاف أن يمسك عذاب بالتنكير المشعر بالتقليل كأنه قال انى أخاف أن يصيبك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Azar rebukes Abraham, uses his name rather than يا أبت, and puts the predicate before the subject because the question of rejecting the idols matters most.
rows.anchor: آزر توبيخا ﴿ أراغب أنت عن آلهتي يا إبراهيم ﴾ أي اترغب عن عبادتها فناداه باسمه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The threat is to stop Abraham insulting the idols; لأرجمنك may mean kill by stones, drive him away by throwing stones, or revile him.
rows.anchor: عن شتم الأصنام ﴿ لأرجمنك ﴾ لأقتلنك بالرجام أولأضربنك بها حتى تتباعد أو لآشتمنك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to leave is coordinated with an implied warning: fear me and leave me.
rows.anchor: عطف على محذوف يدل عليه لارجمنك تقديره فاحذرنى واهجرنى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: مليا is a temporal adverb meaning for a long time, derived from a word for an extended period.
rows.anchor: ظرف أي زمانا طويلا من الملاوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: سلام عليك may be a farewell and separation or a kindly, conciliatory parting; this explains his promise to seek forgiveness.
rows.anchor: سلام توديع ومتاركة أو تقريب وملاطفة ولذا وعد بالاستغفار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Seeking forgiveness means asking God to make Azar among those forgiven by guiding him to Islam.
rows.anchor: سأسأل الله أن يجعلك من أهل المغفرة بأن يهديك للاسلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ḥafiyyan means graciously gentle through blessings, merciful, or honoring; ḥifāwah denotes compassion, mercy, or honor.
rows.anchor: ملطفا بعموم النعم أو رحيما أو مكرما والحفاوة الرأفة والرحمة والكرامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham's separation means migration from Babylon to Syria; what his people invoke besides God means their idols.
rows.anchor: أراد بالاعتزال المهاجرة من أرض بابل إلى الشام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: دعوا means worship, and Abraham's expression of hope humbles himself while hinting at his people's wretchedness for worshipping idols.
rows.anchor: واعبد ﴿ ربي ﴾ ثم قال تواضعا وهضما للنفس ومعرضا بشقاوتهم بدعاء آلهتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He hopes not to fail by worshipping his Lord as they failed through worshipping idols.
rows.anchor: أي كما شقيتم أنتم بعبادة الأصنام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After Abraham left the unbelievers and their idols, God gave him Isaac and Jacob; Jacob was an additional gift to provide companionship.
rows.anchor: ولما اعتزل الكفار ومعبودهم ﴿ وهبنا له إسحاق ﴾ ولدا ﴿ ويعقوب ﴾ نافلة ليستأنس بهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Both sons were made prophets; God compensated Abraham for leaving wicked unbelievers with believing prophetic children.
rows.anchor: كل واحد منهما ﴿ جعلنا نبيا ﴾ أي لما ترك الكفار الفجار لوجهه عوضه أولادا مؤمنين أنبياء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's mercy to Abraham's family includes wealth and children.
rows.anchor: ﴿ ووهبنا لهم من رحمتنا ﴾ هي المال والولد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A lofty good reputation means praise, including blessings upon Abraham and his family in ritual prayers; tongue stands for speech, as hand can stand for a gift.
rows.anchor: ثناء حسنا وهو الصلاة على إبراهيم وآل إبراهيم في الصلوات وعبر باللسان عما يوجد باللسان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: عليا means elevated and renowned.
rows.anchor: ﴿ عليا ﴾ رفيعا مشهورا

rows.speaker: الكوفي غير المفضل
rows.claim: The Kufan reading, except al-Mufaddal's, has mukhlaṣan: God purified Moses and chose him.
rows.anchor: كوفي غير المفضل أي أخلصه الله واصطفاه

rows.speaker: غيرهم
rows.claim: Other readers have mukhliṣan: Moses himself devoted his worship to God, sincerely and with an innate disposition toward felicity.
rows.anchor: أخلص هو العبادة لله تعالى فهو مخلص بماله من السعادة باصل الفطرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A messenger is one who has a Book; a prophet communicates from God even without a Book, as Joshua did.
rows.anchor: ﴿ وكان رسولا نبيا ﴾ الرسول الذي معه كتاب الأنبياء والنبي الذي ينبيء عن الله عز وجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God called and spoke to Moses on Friday night.
rows.anchor: ﴿ وناديناه ﴾ دعوناه وكلمناه ليلة الجمعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Mount is between Egypt and Midian; the right side means Moses's right, because a mountain itself has no right side.
rows.anchor: هو جبل بين مصر ومدين ﴿ الأيمن ﴾ من اليمين أي من ناحية اليمين والجمهور على ان المراد أيمن موسى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As Moses traveled from Midian toward Egypt, a call came from the tree on the mountain's side to his right.
rows.anchor: المعنى انه حين أقبل من مدين يريد مصر نودي من الشجرة وكانت في جانب الجبل على يمين موسى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's drawing near means nearness in rank and status, not physical place or distance.
rows.anchor: تقريب منزلة ومكانة لا منزل ومكان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: نجيا is a circumstantial form meaning one speaking confidentially, like نديم meaning companion in intimate conversation.
rows.anchor: حال أي مناجيا كنديم بمعنى منادم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Harun was granted to Moses out of mercy and compassion; the apposition identifies the brother, and نبيّا is circumstantial.
rows.anchor: من أجل رحمتنا وترؤفنا عليه ﴿ أخاه ﴾ مفعول ﴿ هارون ﴾ بدل منه ﴿ نبيا ﴾ حال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What God granted was his brother's prophethood, since Harun was older than Moses.
rows.anchor: أي وهبنا له نبوة أخيه والا فهرون كان أكبر سنا منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The soundest view identifies Ishmael as Abraham's son.
rows.anchor: هو ابن إبراهيم في الاصح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ishmael fulfilled a promise to wait in place for a man; he waited a year until the man returned.
rows.anchor: وافيه وعد رجلا أن يقيم مكانه حتى يعود اليه فانتظر سنة في مكانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He also promised patience through being sacrificed and kept that promise.
rows.anchor: ناهيك انه وعد من نسفه الصبر على الذبح فوفى

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another view says Ishmael never made a promise without fulfilling it.
rows.anchor: وقيل لم يعدر به موعدا الا أنجزه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although other prophets also kept promises, this trait is singled out to honor Ishmael because it was especially renowned in him.
rows.anchor: وانما خصه بصدق الوعد وان كان موجودا في غيره من الانبياء تشريفا له ولأنه المشهور من خصاله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He was a messenger to Jurhum and a prophet who informed and warned.
rows.anchor: ﴿ وكان رسولا ﴾ إلى جرهم ﴿ نبيا ﴾ مخبرا منذرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His household means his community, because a prophet is the father of his community and people; this also shows that he did not flatter others.
rows.anchor: أمته لأن النبي أبو أمته وأهل بيته وفيه دليل على أنه لم يداهن غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prayer and zakat are singled out because they exemplify bodily and financial acts of worship.
rows.anchor: يحتمل انه انما خصت هاتان العبادتان لانهما أما العبادات البدنية والمالية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A variant reading is given as مرضوا according to the original form.
rows.anchor: ﴿ وكان عند ربه مرضيا ﴾ قريء مرضوا على الأصل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Idris is Enoch, the first messenger after Adam; he first wrote with a pen, sewed clothing, studied stars and mathematics, made weights, measures, and weapons, and fought Cain's descendants.
rows.anchor: هو اخنوخ اول مرسل بعد آدم عليه السلام وأول من خط بالقلم وخاط اللباس ونظر في علم النجوم والحساب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The claim that Idris was named for extensive study of God's books is unsound: if the word derived from study, it would have only one cause preventing declension and should be declinable.
rows.anchor: وقولهم سمي به لكثرة دراسته كتب الله لا يصح لأنه لو كان إفعيلا من الدرس لم يكن فيه إلا سبب واحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Its nondeclension proves that Idris is foreign in origin.
rows.anchor: وكان منصرفا فامتناعه من الصرف دليل العجمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God sent Idris thirty scripture sheets.
rows.anchor: أنزل الله عليه ثلاثين صحيفة
